data.body: **P2 — Avoid reloading environment plugins in the old-core fallback.** This list already includes plugins selected through `DURABLE_EXECUTION_PLUGINS`; passing it to a fresh older-core builder makes that builder discover the environment plugin again. Because the released core lacks exclusive-group validation, both instances receive hooks, producing duplicate OTel spans and context management for a valid single-view configuration. Ensure this fallback does not feed dynamically loaded plugins back through discovery, or reject environment-selected plugins when `toBuilder` is unavailable, and add a released-core test using the actual environment variable.
